# Kaedim

> > Kaedim is an AI-powered 3D asset production platform that combines automated modeling with expert artist review to deliver AAA-quality, production-ready 3D assets for studios, brands, and enterprises.

Kaedim serves game studios, Fortune 100 companies, and ecommerce retailers by automating 3D asset creation through Image to 3D AI technology while maintaining human quality control. The platform is trusted by AAA game studios and enterprise clients for fast turnaround, cost-effective outsourcing, and pipeline optimization.
